Help us to love Christ more than we love anything. Help us to believe Christ more than we believe anything. I pray, God that you would help us to put to death our idols. Anything in our life that we think is more satisfying than God, I pray, God that you would begin to bring tension, that you would begin to bring disruption, that you would begin to create circumstances where you discipline us so that we would be more righteous.
